warnings: The main building's sheets (หน้า 05-13, แผ่นที่ 1-9 of แบบ 101ล/27) print NO grid bubbles — only dimension chains (the circled ก/ข/A/B marks on the plans are section-cut markers). Labels were assigned following the precedent of houses 155/157 (other unlabelled สพฐ. sets): numbers 1-11 on the eleven column lines along x, left to right as drawn (10 bays x 4.00 = 40.00); letters A-G on the seven column rows along y, top to bottom as drawn (4.00 / 4.00 / 2.00 / 2.00 / 4.00 / 4.00 = 20.00). Origin A1 (top-left).
All seven rows carry a column somewhere: A, C, E, G on every grid; B and F only on grids 1, 10 and 11; D only at the left porch column (F1C1 at -4.625). Interior grids 2-9 have no column on B, D, F.

The drawing set is two buildings: pages 02-04 (แบบอาคารส่วนต่อเติม โรงอาหาร 101ล./27 (พิเศษ), แผ่นที่ 1-3/3) are a separate single-storey extension strip with its own printed grid 1-10 x A-B — it has its own master, หน้า00b_gridline_ส่วนต่อเติม.json (section 11a). Nothing in this master refers to it.

x: the 2nd-floor plan and the canopy plan end 2.00 past grid 10 (38.00, the balcony edge) while the ground floor continues to grid 11 (40.00) and the 1.10 strip at 41.10 — the bay 10-11 carries the two end stairs (2nd-floor plan, B19/B20/B21). The roof plan covers grid 1 to grid 10 only (36.00 + 1.60 eaves); the bay beyond it is the separate front porch roof (แปลนคานหลังคาและโครงหลังคามุขด้านหน้า).

The middle y chain printed between the two plans on หน้า10 (1.00 / .90 / 20.00 / .90 / 1.00) is placed against the ground-floor plan beside it: the .90 rows run from row B to 4.90 and from 15.10 to row F (a thickened wall/column segment drawn on grid 11 at the stair ends); the two 1.00 rows sit outside rows A and G. No member read in op04 lands on -1.00 / 21.00 / 4.90 / 15.10 — they exist because section 4 rule 4 makes every anchored tick a line. Placement of this chain is a judgement call (it sits between two plans drawn at slightly different heights); confidence lowered.

The right stair chains (2.475 / 1.20 / 2.475 into row C and out of row E) and the left stair chains (0.75 / 2.50 / 0.75 on the floor plan = 1.25 / 1.25 about row D on the 2nd-floor plan) are recorded the same way.
Roof-plan x chain: the 7th 4.00 is printed with a smudged last digit ('4.06'); every other bay and both the canopy and floor chains print 4.00 — read as 4.00.

z_levels[]: the first pass took them from section A-A on หน้า07 only (1.25 / 0.20 / 0.20 / 3.70 / 3.50 / 3.50 / 2.65, ±0.00 at the top of the 1.25 row per the long-pile notes 'ไม่น้อยกว่า 1.25 ม. จากระดับ ±0.00'). The second op04 pass (2026-10-22) swept the elevations of หน้า05-06 (no level marks printed on any of the three), section B-B on หน้า07 (anchored, see its chain note) and the ground-floor plan's level marks (+0.20 / +0.35 / +0.40 — +0.35 added).
Scanned government set (กองออกแบบและก่อสร้าง กรมสามัญศึกษา, แบบเลขที่ 101ล/27); every value was read off zoomed crops of the page images.

Second op04 pass (2026-10-22), dimension sweep of the sheets the first pass had not swept tick by tick: หน้า05 (แปลนพื้นชั้นล่าง + รูปด้านข้าง), หน้า06 (แปลนพื้นชั้นบน, แปลนพื้นชั้นลอยเหนือเวที, แปลนเสา คาน ตง พื้นเวที, รูปด้านหลัง, รูปด้านหน้า), หน้า07 (รูปตัด A-A x/y rows and รูปตัด B-B). The three elevations print NO level marks and NO dimension rows (only notes; the two numbers on them went to unassigned_dimensions) — z comes only from the two sections and the +0.20 / +0.35 / +0.40 marks on the ground-floor plan.

รูปตัด B-B prints its left z row as 1.25 / 3.70 / 3.50 / 3.50 / 2.65 (14.60) while A-A prints 1.25 / 0.20 / 0.20 / 3.70 / 3.50 / 3.50 / 2.65 (15.00). On B-B the 1.25 is drawn from the footing base (-1.25) up to the tick it shares with the 3.70, i.e. the +0.40 floor (drawn ≈1.73 m at 1:75), so the row absorbed A-A's two 0.20 rows into a segment still labelled 1.25. Anchored as drawn (-1.25 → +0.40) and kept as printed; it does not close (levels say 1.65) — the first pass had left this row as unanchored 'edge' ends.

New points from this sweep: x -4.475 (2.475 flight from 1'''' printed on หน้า06 and หน้า10 — the landing side ends on the 1.25 row at -4.625 with an unlabelled 0.15 gap between the two ticks); x 38.90 (2.20 stair width back from the 1.10 line on หน้า05 and หน้า06, closed on หน้า06 by 2.00 + .90 from grid 10); y 5.00 and 15.00 (1.00 + 1.00 from rows B and F on the stage framing plan, the same 1.00 printed twice on the canopy plan's control-room stair strips); y 17.00 (toilet cubicle depth 1.00 from row F, หน้า06 — drawn ≈1.5 m, printed value used). The stage plan's second 1.00 lands exactly on the existing 6.00 and 14.00 lines (first pass: scaled B14 lines), which are therefore printed positions now.

Beam lines added without a printed chain (section 4 beam-endpoint rule, positions scaled or derived — per-line flags): x 1.35 and 2.75 (the two short 'B' beams of the S3 toilet group), x 1.875 (B9 of the S3 group, from the printed 1.65 | .15 | 1.90 of ขยาย S3), x 3.20 (the 'B' beam of the control-room stair strips on the canopy plan).

unassigned_dimensions from this sweep keep only dimension-like numbers (heights, thicknesses, offsets); material/section designations printed on the architectural sheets (tile sizes, timber sizes, steel C100x50x20x3.2 @1.00, rebar callouts) are not grid data and stay unrecorded here — the same selection the first pass made.
